newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF determined on vigorous reforms - Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: MOF determined on vigorous reforms - Sakakibara.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry is determined to carry out financial reforms vigorously, Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, told a meeting of currency dealers on Wednesday.
"The Finance Ministry will carry out Tokyo's 'Big Bang' vigorously, as instructed by Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto," he said.
Financial deregulation in Japan would basically be good for Japanese banks and raise their status, he said.
"Such deregulation had better be carried out as soon as possible," he added.
Hashimoto has pledged to complete Japan's Big Bang, a sweeping programme of financial deregulation, by 2001.
